description: Recent notifications: comments, likes, follows, mentions. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

limit.description: Max notifications to return, 1-200, default 50. Newest first.

type.description: Filter: all (default), comments, likes, follows or mentions.

name: notifications_list
title: Notifications list
